name: STAR Attitude — unit quaternions and rotation matrices (one stated convention)
summary: Unit quaternion algebra, rotation matrices and axis-angle with a fixed, tested convention (scalar first, Hamilton, active rotation); agrees with NAIF SPICE and SciPy to 9e-16 and refuses non-unit quaternions and non-rotation matrices instead of normalising them silently.
reference: NAIF SPICE Rotations Required Reading: the unit quaternion (cos(t/2), sin(t/2) u) is the rotation by t about u; rotation by +90 degrees about +Z takes +X to +Y, matrix [[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]]
reference_observed: quarter turns about the three axes, the matrix of the +Z quarter turn and the Hamilton relations reproduced to 1e-12; SPICE q2m, m2q, qxq agree on 411 cases to 9e-16

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: normalize, conjugate, multiply, rotate, to_dcm, from_dcm, from_axis_angle, to_axis_angle, angle_between_deg
review.G-04: degrees for angles; quaternion (w, x, y, z) scalar first, active rotation: stated in docstring and README and fixed by the tests
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input, including non-unit quaternions and non-rotation matrices; no iteration
